::::: about-container
::: about-text
I am a fourth-year undergraduate pursuing a BSc (Hons) in Statistics at the [Department of Statistics, University of Sri Jayewardenepura](https://science.sjp.ac.lk/sta/), with a strong background in Mathematics and Economics. I completed my primary and secondary education at [Maliyadeva Balika Vidyalaya](http://maliyadevabalika.lk/). Currently, I am conducting my final-year undergraduate research under the supervision of [Prof. Sarath Banneheka](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarath-banneheka-6403a660/) and I am seeking internship opportunities in data analysis, statistics, or research-oriented roles.

I am passionate about **data analysis, statistical modeling, and programming in R**.  My interests include Advanced Statistical Inference, Probability and Distribution Theory, Regression Analysis, Statistical Quality Control, Time Series Analysis, Data Visualization, and real-world problem solving using data.

I enjoy transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support decision-making. By combining knowledge from Statistics, Mathematics, and Economics, I aim to develop data-driven solutions to complex problems and contribute to informed decision-making across various domains.
:::
